senses.definition: (African-American Vernacular or slang) Awake: conscious and not asleep.
(originally African-American Vernacular, slang) Alert, aware of what is going on, or well-informed, especially of racial and other social justice issues.

quotes.text: Waking up is a damn sight harder than going to sleep, but we’ll stay woke up longer.

quotes.text: The famous author of Harry Potter, J K Rowling, found herself at the centre of a woke storm after liking a tweet by Maya Forstater, who lost her job in 2019 after tweeting that “male people are not women”. The boycott of Bud Light over the company’s paid promotional social media posts using trans influencer Dylan Mulvaney is another.

quotes.text: The woke right and woke left demand that we internalize our status as victim.
